description: This file defines the KeyboardService class for managing keyboard shortcuts, event handling, and command execution in a UI application. It includes methods for registering shortcuts, handling key events, and managing active modifiers, tailored for different platforms (e.g., Mac or non-Mac).

classes.name: KeyboardService
classes.description: Main class handling keyboard shortcut management, event listening, and command execution based on platform and environment context.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Removes event listeners and clears command handlers, de-initializing the service.

methods.name: addActiveModifier
methods.description: Adds a keyboard modifier to the active set depending on platform-specific logic.

methods.name: removeActiveModifier
methods.description: Removes a keyboard modifier from the active set.

methods.name: handleComponentKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events originating from components, updating active modifiers.

methods.name: handleComponentKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key up events originating from components, updating active modifiers.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Internal handler for keydown events, updates modifiers and processes shortcuts.

methods.name: handleKeyUp
methods.description: Internal handler for keyup events, updates modifiers and processes shortcuts.

methods.name: updateAllModifiersFromEvent
methods.description: Synchronizes active modifiers with the current keyboard event state.

methods.name: handleWindowBlur
methods.description: Clears active modifiers when window loses focus.

methods.name: handleKeyboardEvent
methods.description: Processes keyboard events to trigger associated commands if matched.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Executes command callbacks, considering element focus and context.

methods.name: triggerCommand
methods.description: Programmatically triggers a command as if the hotkey was pressed.

methods.name: registerShortcut
methods.description: Associates a KeyboardShortcut with a command in the shortcut map.

methods.name: addCommandHandler
methods.description: Adds a command handler observer, returning a disposer function.

methods.name: addCommandHandlers
methods.description: Adds multiple command handlers at once, returning a disposer for all.

methods.name: keyboardShortcutForCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the shortcut details for a given command, including platform info.

ctags.name: callback
ctags.pattern: /^      const callback = keyEvent === KeyboardKeyEvent.Down ? observer.onKeyDown : observer.onKeyU/

ctags.name: observer
ctags.pattern: /^      const callback = keyEvent === KeyboardKeyEvent.Down ? observer.onKeyDown : observer.onKeyU/
